ITEM 1 | Beige-grey porridge-like mass with a coarse, granular, slightly lumpy texture and matte, moist-looking surface; soft and spreadable, holds a mound shape with slight spreading at the edges; fills roughly 70% of a white cereal bowl about 15 cm across, sitting to about 2.5 cm depth at center | 260

ITEM 2 | Scattered bright red, wrinkled, semi-dried pieces about 1-2 cm long, glossy and slightly leathery, clustered in the right-center of the porridge surface and sitting on top of it; covering roughly 8% of the bowl's visible contents | 8
